Name: Old Red Crosses
Author: jecowa
Description:
This mod brings back the old familiar crosses and colors them in the same shades of red as used in prior versions of Stardew Valley.

This mod requires SMAPI and Content Patcher. It should work great with every language setting.

This mod makes the following changes:

[list]
[*]Changes the color of the cross found on the clinic storefront from blue to red.
[*]Changes the color of a cross found on a particular hat from blue to red.
[*]Changes the color of crosses found on a few signs in the clinic from blue to red.
[*]Changes health bar icon from a red H to a red plus sign.
[*]Changes food health tooltip icon from a red H to a red plus sign.
[*]Changes another red 'H' icon in the cursors file into a cross. (I'm not sure what it's for– maybe a buff for increased max health?)
[/list]
This mod takes great advantage of the Content Patcher feature that allows it to edit a very specific portion of a texture, so it should be fairly compatible with other mods:

[list]
[*]It should work fine with portrait and sprite mods as long as they don't change the size or location of the cross on Maru's hat.
[*]It should work with UI mods if they don't change the health bar too much.
[*]It should work with mods that change colors of buildings.
[*]It should work with mods that change the appearance of buildings as long as they don't move the cross on the clinic.
[*]It should work with mods that change the interiors of buildings if they don't mess with the two signs that have crosses on them too much.[/list]

Manifest.Name: Old Red Crosses
Manifest.Description: Changes crosses back to their old red colors.
